name: Draugar
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons
languages: The languages it knew in life
notes: CR 6. Large. Boss creature. Undead fortitude. Swelling rage.
gm_notes: Session 3 forest boss. Undead Fortitude: when reduced to 0 HP, DC 5+damage dealt CON save (not vs radiant or crits) -- on success drops to 1 HP instead. Swelling Rage at 60 HP or less: grows Large size, gains bonus slam attack. Resistance to nonmagical weapons. Two-phase fight.
